newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium ends mixed as dlr fails to inspire.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium ends mixed as dlr fails to inspire.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures ended mixed on Monday in featureless trade where the dollar's rise was offset by the metal's dip in London on Friday, traders said.
"Until either the LME (aluminium) price or the foreign exchange rate shows major movement, we can't really move," said one trader at a major trading house.

The dollar's rise to above 115 yen following the Denver G7 summit over the weekend failed to attract buyers, partly as three-month aluminium on the LME did not rise towards $1,600 last week, finishing at $1,578 per tonne, traders said.
The benchmark April 1998 contract shed 0.1 yen to finish at 190.2 yen per kilo, while other contracts added between 0.1 and 0.3 yen.
The estimated volume was a thin 1,002 lots.
